name: autotask-mcp
description: Connects Claude Desktop to the hosted Autotask MCP server, with your Autotask API credentials kept encrypted by Claude Desktop.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to the Autotask MCP Regional endpoint for your Autotask zone. Claude Desktop stores the API secret and the integration code encrypted with your operating system's protection for your user account, and passes them to this extension when it starts. The extension relays each MCP message to the hosted server unchanged, using the official MCP SDK's Streamable HTTP transport, and adds the three Autotask credential headers. It sends them to the Autotask MCP endpoint you configure and to no other host.

endpoint.title: Autotask MCP endpoint
endpoint.description: The MCP endpoint for your Autotask zone: take your Autotask API host, replace webservices with mcp, and add /mcp. For webservices3.autotask.net it is https://mcp3.autotask.net/mcp.

username.title: API username
username.description: The username of your Autotask API-only user.

secret.title: API secret
secret.description: The secret (password) of your Autotask API-only user. Claude Desktop stores it encrypted.

integration_code.title: API integration code
integration_code.description: The API tracking identifier (integration code) of your Autotask API-only user. Claude Desktop stores it encrypted.
